title: CommitKV: Commit-Aligned KV Cache Compression for Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.07855v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal agents gather visual evidence through reasoning and tool use, extending their ability to solve tasks beyond the initial input. However, accumulating observations increases KV cache memory and inference costs. Token eviction reduces these costs by retaining useful cached tokens. Existing methods use attention, redundancy, or stage-specific queries to rank tokens, without explicitly comparing the same history across tool interactions. When observations shift attention, they may mistake temporarily reduced influence for lost usefulness and evict information needed later. We propose CommitKV, a training-free KV cache compression method that accounts for this changing evidence use. Commit-aligned measurement compares the deletion effects of the same page before a tool call completes and after its observation returns. translated_title: CommitKV：面向多模态智能体的提交对齐KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体通过推理和工具使用来收集视觉证据，将其解决任务的能力扩展到初始输入之外。然而，不断累积的观察结果会增加KV缓存的内存占用和推理成本。令牌驱逐（token eviction）通过保留有用的缓存令牌来降低这些成本。现有方法使用注意力、冗余度或特定阶段的查询来对令牌排序，却没有在工具交互之间显式比较同一历史记录。当观察结果使注意力发生转移时，这些方法可能将暂时降低的影响力误判为失去用处，从而驱逐掉后续需要的信息。我们提出了CommitKV，一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩方法，能够应对这种不断变化的证据使用方式。提交对齐测量在工具调用完成之前和其观察结果返回之后，比较对同一页面的删除影响。生命周期感知压缩会淘汰在两个时间窗口中影响力都很低的页面，并暂时保护影响力发生变化的页面……（原文在此截断）
tldr: CommitKV是一种无需训练的多模态智能体KV缓存压缩方法，通过对比工具调用前后对同一缓存页面的删除影响来捕捉证据使用的变化，淘汰两个时间窗口中影响力均低的页面并暂时保护被观察激活的页面，避免因注意力转移而误删后续需要的信息。
en_tdlr: CommitKV is a training-free KV cache compression method for multimodal agents that measures the deletion effects of the same cache pages before a tool call completes and after its observation returns, retiring pages with low influence in both windows while temporarily protecting observation-activated pages, thereby avoiding mistakenly evicting information needed later due to attention shifts.
